topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: Hey, you won't believe what happened today! I came home, and there on the doorstep, no kidding, a beautiful bouquet of daisies, no card, nothing. Just those lovely, goofy flowers staring me in the face. It's got me scratching my head, wondering who might have sent them. Part of me hopes it's from someone thinking of me, you know? But mostly, I’m just happy to see such a cheerful surprise, no matter who sent them. I mean, who wouldn’t love a mystery wrapped in petals? I can't wait to figure out who’s behind it, but for now, I'm just going to enjoy the thought of someone out there spreading a little joy my way.
